sections.title: 他们是谁？
sections.translation: Who are they? They are my dad and mom. Mom’s hair is long. Dad’s hair is short.

sections.title: 她们是谁？
sections.translation: Who are they? They are my older sister and younger sister. My older sister is tall. My younger sister is short.

sections.title: 它们是谁？
sections.translation: Who are they? They are my little cat and little dog. The little cat is plump. The little dog is thin.

妈妈的头发长: mā ma de tóu fa cháng
爸爸的头发短: bà ba de tóu fa duǎn
姐姐的个子高: jiě jie de gè zi gāo
妹妹的个子矮: mèi mei de gè zi ǎi

theme.py: wǒ de jiā rén hé xiǎo dòng wù

sections.cn: 妈妈的头发长，爸爸的头发短。
sections.py: mā ma de tóu fa cháng, bà ba de tóu fa duǎn.
sections.en: Mom has long hair, and Dad has short hair.

sections.cn: 姐姐的个子高，妹妹的个子矮。
sections.py: jiě jie de gè zi gāo, mèi mei de gè zi ǎi.
sections.en: My older sister is tall, and my younger sister is short.

sections.cn: 小猫胖胖的，小狗瘦瘦的。
sections.py: xiǎo māo pàng pàng de, xiǎo gǒu shòu shòu de.
sections.en: The little cat is plump, and the little dog is thin.
